import os,glob,re
def load():

    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load(); print(sorted(G))

program_source = f'''from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    g=[r[:] for r in grid]; H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    cnt=Counter(x for r in g for x in r)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    line=None; vert=None
    for c in range(W):
        if all(g[r][c]==2 for r in range(H)): line,vert=c,True
    for r in range(H):
        if all(g[r][c]==2 for c in range(W)): line,vert=r,False
    sc=[k for k in cnt if k not in (bg,2)][0]
    cells=[(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if g[r][c]==sc]
    if vert:
        if min(c for r,c in cells)>line:
            gap=min(c for r,c in cells)-line-1; dr,dc=0,-gap
        else:
            gap=line-max(c for r,c in cells)-1; dr,dc=0,gap
    else:
        if min(r for r,c in cells)>line:
            gap=min(r for r,c in cells)-line-1; dr,dc=-gap,0
        else:
            gap=line-max(r for r,c in cells)-1; dr,dc=gap,0
    for r,c in cells: g[r][c]=bg
    for r,c in cells: g[r+dr][c+dc]=sc
    cells=[(r+dr,c+dc) for r,c in cells]
    if vert:
        mc=(max(c for r,c in cells)+1) if min(c for r,c in cells)>line else (min(c for r,c in cells)-1)
        for r in range(H): g[r][mc]=8
    else:
        mr=(min(r for r,c in cells)-1) if max(r for r,c in cells)<line else (max(r for r,c in cells)+1)
        for c in range(W): g[mr][c]=8
    return g
'''
